06 / 09 · Better coaches. Stronger pathways. A better game.

Coach Development

Developing coaches is just as important as developing players. Through community coaching courses, practical mentoring and our Aotearoa Coaches Association (ACA), we help coaches grow from their first whistle to senior football.

Talk coach development
THE PROTEUS WAY / COACHES & CLUBS

WHO IT’S FOR

New and developing coaches, school and club coaches, and organisations that want to host a course or develop their coaching team.

01

Community coaching courses

Practical football coach education, including FUN-damentals of Junior Coaching, Junior Level 1 and Youth Level 1, organised with clubs and community groups.

02

Coach mentoring

Session planning, feedback and shared learning from a network spanning grassroots, youth, academy and senior football.

03

Aotearoa Coaches Association

Our coach development and networking arm, with study tours through England, Spain and Italy and priority pathways into Proteus roles.

  • 3 coursesFrom junior to youth level
  • EuropeACA study tours
  • ~60Coaches in our network

What our network gives coaches

  • Meaningful, paid coaching work
  • Quick onboarding into sessions
  • Reliable fortnightly payments
  • Mentoring and professional development
  • Pathways with universities and coaching institutes
  • Networking, travel and industry connections

HERE TO HELP

GOOD
QUESTIONS.

Ask us something else
Which coaching courses do you run?

Practical football coach education, including FUN-damentals of Junior Coaching, Junior Level 1 and Youth Level 1, organised with clubs and community groups.

What is the Aotearoa Coaches Association?

Our coach development and networking arm, with study tours through England, Spain and Italy and priority pathways into Proteus roles.

Can you run a course at our club?

Yes. Courses are organised with clubs and community groups. Get in touch to talk about hosting one or developing your coaching team.

What is it like to coach with Proteus?

You join a network of nearly 60 coaches with quick onboarding into sessions, reliable fortnightly payments and a strong focus on support and retention. We help coaches gain experience, develop professionally and find pathways into the industry.

People first.
Development always.
